stories.title: Norris Wins Hungarian GP — Verstappen's Red Bull Exit Clause Now Officially Active

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Lando Norris wins the Hungarian GP. 🏆

Max Verstappen finishes P2 — but that result still leaves him outside the top 2 in the championship.

His Red Bull exit clause is now officially active.

Red Bull offered €8 million to buy it out. He said no.

McLaren awaits. 👀

#F1 #HungarianGP

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Max Verstappen's Red Bull exit clause is active.

He's outside the top 2 heading into the summer break.

Red Bull tried to buy out the clause. He refused.

An October deadline is coming. McLaren is waiting.

The most significant driver market story of the summer is just getting started. 🔴

#F1

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Lewis Hamilton has received 4 F1 penalties across 3 consecutive race weekends.

Including: a 5-second penalty at Monaco for going 0.1 km/h over the pit lane limit.

He sits 50 points behind Antonelli.

Every call is costing him ground he cannot get back. 🔴

x_posts.text:

Sky Sports asked: is it proportionate?

The short answer: the rulebook says yes.

The context says this is becoming a problem for his championship chances. ⚙️

stories.title: Antonelli's Championship Lead — What 219 Points and a 50-Point Buffer Means

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
Kimi Antonelli enters the F1 summer break with 219 points.

Lewis Hamilton: 169 points.

Gap: 50.

Antonelli's stats in 11 starts: 6 wins. 6 poles. 9 podiums.

If he wins this title, he's the youngest F1 champion since Sebastian Vettel in 2010. 🏆

stories.title: FIA Admits Leclerc Should Have Been Penalized at Spa — But Won't Act

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
The FIA stewards admitted it.

At the Belgian GP, Leclerc squeezed Piastri into Les Combes. Contact. Floor damage.

No penalty at the time. Now the stewards say: "we would judge the incident differently now."

But no retroactive action is being taken.

The call was wrong. It stands. ⚠️

#F1

This is going to be something special. 🏎️
